title: The cell categories ]X[ and [X]
body_html:
The cell categories $]X[$ and $[X]$

Let $X$ be a locally finite regular CW complex (see Locally finite regular CW complex with cellular G-action).

Definition. The category $]X[$ has

  • objects: the cells of $X$;
  • morphisms: $\Hom_{]X[}(E,F)$ is a singleton if $E \preceq F$ (i.e.\ $E \subseteq \overline{F}$), and empty otherwise.

The opposite category is $[X] := ]X[^{\mathrm{op}}$.

This is the face poset of $X$ viewed as a thin category; the notation $]X[$ / $[X]$ follows [Dat]. Functors out of $]X[$ become sheaves on $X$ (see Sheaves and cosheaves on X as functor categories); functors out of $[X]$ become cosheaves.

For the trivial group, $]X/\{e\}[ \,=\, ]X[$.
